description: Fetch the full detail record for a single agent by UUID, including verification state and metadata. Judge the agent by `risk_level`, not the raw overall_risk_score: 'not_verified' means nobody has paid to assess it yet and scores 100 by presumption, which is not a finding against the agent. Costs $0.001 USDC per call when paying with x402.
name: get_agent
title: Get agent detail
